import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 8;
    static final int SZ = 1048576 + 5;

    static int n;
    static int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int inv100;
    static int[][] edges = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] prob = new int[SZ];
    static int[][][] tripleMask = new int[7][7][7];
    static int all, Ans;

    static int power(int x, int k) {
        int res = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) res = mul(res, x);
            x = mul(x, x);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int inc(int a, int b) {
        int s = a + b;
        return s >= MOD ? s - MOD : s;
    }

    static int dec(int a, int b) {
        int d = a - b;
        return d < 0 ? d + MOD : d;
    }

    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static void updata(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] = inc(x[0], y);
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] lis = {0, x, y, z};
        int[] pos = {0, 1, 2, 3};
        // generate all permutations of pos[1..3]
        do {
            boolean ok = true;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                if (edges[pos[i]][lis[i]] == 0) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (ok) return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(pos));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr) {
        int i = arr.length - 2;
        while (i >= 1 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 1) return false;
        int j = arr.length - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) j--;
        swap(arr, i, j);
        reverse(arr, i + 1, arr.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int l, int r) {
        while (l < r) {
            swap(arr, l, r);
            l++;
            r--;
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(int now, int x, int y) {
        if (now == 0) return;
        if (x == 4) {
            boolean[] used = new boolean[7];
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) used[i] = true;
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) {
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = false;
                            int X = -1, Y = -1, Z = -1;
                            for (int l = 1; l <= 6; l++) {
                                if (used[l]) {
                                    if (X == -1) X = l;
                                    else if (Y == -1) Y = l;
                                    else Z = l;
                                }
                            }
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = true;
                            if (Z == -1) continue;
                            sta |= tripleMask[X][Y][Z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            prob[sta] = inc(prob[sta], now);
            return;
        }
        edges[x][y] = 1;
        int nxt = mul(now, a[x][y]);
        if (y == 6) dfs1(nxt, x + 1, 1);
        else dfs1(nxt, x, y + 1);
        edges[x][y] = 0;
        nxt = mul(now, dec(1, a[x][y]));
        if (y == 6) dfs1(nxt, x + 1, 1);
        else dfs1(nxt, x, y + 1);
    }

    static void dfs2(int now, int x, int y) {
        if (now == 0) return;
        if (x == 7) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) sta |= tripleMask[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            Ans = inc(Ans, mul(now, prob[all ^ sta]));
            return;
        }
        edges[x - 3][y] = 1;
        int nxt = mul(now, a[x][y]);
        if (y == 6) dfs2(nxt, x + 1, 1);
        else dfs2(nxt, x, y + 1);
        edges[x - 3][y] = 0;
        nxt = mul(now, dec(1, a[x][y]));
        if (y == 6) dfs2(nxt, x + 1, 1);
        else dfs2(nxt, x, y + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        inv100 = power(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = sc.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = mul(a[i][j], inv100);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) a[i][i] = 1;
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    tripleMask[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt;
                    cnt++;
                }
            }
        }
        all = (1 << cnt) - 1;
        dfs1(1, 1, 1);
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << cnt); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    prob[i] = inc(prob[i], prob[i ^ (1 << j)]);
                }
            }
        }
        Ans = 0;
        dfs2(1, 4, 1);
        Ans = dec(1, Ans);
        System.out.println(Ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
